Overall quality of an agent's performance based on evaluations. Raw points earned divided by possible points across all evaluated interactions.
Score for a specific category within a QA evaluation form (e.g. Greeting, Call Handling, Accuracy, Soft Skills). Identifies strengths or improvement areas per category.
Count of deductions from a QA score due to failures in specific criteria. Highlights critical errors or missed compliance steps.
Percentage of evaluations where the agent was compliant at attribute level (Total Yes / Total Yes + No for a given attribute)
Percentage of instances where the agent was not compliant with required standards (Total No / Total Yes + No for a given attribute)
Customer Satisfaction Score — percentage of customers who rated their interaction as satisfactory
Process adherence score for mandatory regulatory procedures (disclosures, identity verification, legal scripts). Derived directly from Call Miner.
Average score tracking contacts that add no value (wrong number, repeat calls, misroutes). Derived directly from Call Miner.
Percentage of escalations resolved by frontline agents without transferring to a supervisor. Derived directly from Call Miner.
How clearly the agent communicated the resolution or information to the customer. Derived directly from Call Miner.
Average score measuring how often customers re-contact within 7 days for the same issue, indicating first-contact resolution failure. Derived directly from Call Miner.
Difference between QA scores given by a supervisor vs the central QA team for the same evaluation. Formula: (BGO Audit QA Score - Supervisor QA Score) * 100
Agent performance against individual QA criteria (call opening, verification, product knowledge, empathy, compliance). Uses Green/Amber/Red scoring where Amber counts as 0.5.
Proportion of evaluated interactions that were followed up with coaching
How closely agent performance evaluations align with organisational standards. Compares supervisor evaluations with central QA audit results.
Total number of evaluated or observed customer interactions used as the base for offer, opportunity, or close metrics

Total hours an agent is logged into the system throughout the day
Duration where an agent is actively engaged in productive work based on presence status (Did Ringing, Ready, On Hold, Manual Dial, On Call, On Review, After Call Work, Offline Work, Ringing)
Total login hours considered as paid time
Sum of total reported hours per day as recorded in the Workday report under Schedule vs Actuals
Total duration spent in non-productive presence statuses (Not Ready, Lunch, Meal, Break, System Issue, In Meeting)

Measures how much of an employee's paid time was spent on productive work. Compares productive hours (calls, chats, emails, after-call work, meetings, approved operational tasks) against total paid hours.

Counts instances where an employee did not meet a required rule, policy, schedule, process, or quality standard. For Affirm Care: any question under 'Ensure a Compliant Conversation that Protects Affirm and our Customers' with answer_label = FAIL is a compliance fail.

Average QA score across all evaluated interactions for the period, expressed relative to the rubric target score. Used when QA scores are pre-computed per interaction rather than calculated from raw/possible points.
Whether the employee was in the correct system status at each scheduled time interval. Formula varies by WFM platform — confirm column names with the data team.
Measures how closely an employee followed their scheduled activities. Compares actual activity (available, breaks, lunch, meetings, offline) against the planned schedule.
Average customer satisfaction score across all surveyed interactions. Used when CSAT is a numeric scale rating (e.g. 1–5 or 0–10) rather than a binary satisfied/dissatisfied response.
Measures how often employees are present for their scheduled workdays. Formula returns absence rate (absences / days in production); attendance % = 1 minus this value.
How often employees were late to their scheduled start time or activity. Formula to be confirmed — supply the late_count and total_scheduled_days columns.
Percentage of employees who left the organisation during the reporting period.
Extra hours worked by employees beyond the regular scheduled hours. Formula to be confirmed — supply overtime hours column.
